Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”) has accepted the Biologics License Application (“BLA”) for lonvoguran ziclumeran (“lonvo-z”) and granted the BLA Priority Review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) target action date of March 10, 2027.

These forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, express or implied statements regarding Intellia’s beliefs and expectations regarding: the success and advancement of its program for lonvo-z (formerly known as NTLA-2002) for the treatment of HAE, including its expectations regarding review and approval of its BLA for lonvo-z, such as whether the FDA will hold an advisory committee to discuss the BLA and the timing of such review and approval based on the PDUFA target action date of March 10, 2027 for the BLA; its belief that lonvo-z could fundamentally change the way HAE is treated and has the potential to become the world's first approved in vivo CRISPR-based therapy; and its expectations regarding its preparations for and the potential success of the commercial launch of lonvo-z, if approved.
